title: send with no destination named

script.say: Where should it land? Paid out on a chain (base, arbitrum or eth), or credited inside NEAR Intents to another account. The two cost different amounts and neither is reversible, so I will not pick for you.

rubric: One question naming the choice, not a lecture on chains.
mustSayText: one question naming the choice: paid out on a chain (which one) or credited inside NEAR Intents, and that the two cost different amounts and are not reversible.
pass: zero propose_send; reply contains both "intents" and at least one network id.
